note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성(2026-10-25 추가). {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a traditional Korean house courtyard with a wooden veranda and curved tile roofs
feature_en: a wooden veranda with a polished plank floor and paper-screen doors
a persimmon tree with orange fruit beside a low earthen wall
ground_en: flat stepping stones leading to the veranda
far_en: curved tile roofs with upturned eaves
a low earthen wall with a wooden gate

맑은 오후.sky_en: a high pale blue sky above the tile roofs
맑은 오후.light_en: warm sunlight comes from above and to the camera's left, falling across {p} face and shoulders and the veranda
맑은 오후.shadow_en: the deep shadow of the eaves falls across the veranda toward the camera's right
맑은 오후.desc_ko: 맑은 가을 오후, 위와 왼쪽에서 오는 따뜻한 햇빛과 처마 그늘

해질녘.sky_en: a soft orange sky behind the tile roofs
해질녘.light_en: low orange sunlight comes from behind {o} on the camera's left, lighting the edges of {p} hair and shoulders and the courtyard
해질녘.shadow_en: long soft shadows of the eaves and the tree stretch across the courtyard toward the camera's right
해질녘.desc_ko: 해 지기 직전, 낮은 주황빛 해가 카메라 왼쪽 뒤에서 비춤

밤 등불.sky_en: a dark blue night sky above the tile roofs
밤 등불.light_en: warm yellow light from paper lanterns hanging under the veranda eaves stands to the camera's left of {o}, falling on {p} face and shoulders
밤 등불.shadow_en: deep soft shadows gather in the courtyard behind {o}
밤 등불.desc_ko: 가을밤, 처마 밑 한지 등불의 따뜻한 노란빛이 카메라 왼쪽에서 비춤

툇마루에 앉기.pose_en: sits on the edge of the wooden veranda with {p} hands resting on the planks beside {o}
툇마루에 앉기.moment_en: {s} looks toward the camera and smiles a little
툇마루에 앉기.desc_ko: 툇마루 끝에 앉아 두 손을 짚고 카메라를 봄

마당에 서기.pose_en: stands in the courtyard with {p} hands clasped in front of {o}
마당에 서기.moment_en: {s} looks toward the camera with a calm smile
마당에 서기.desc_ko: 마당에 서서 두 손을 모으고 카메라를 봄

문기둥에 기대 서기.pose_en: stands beside a wooden pillar of the veranda with one hand resting on it
문기둥에 기대 서기.moment_en: {s} turns {p} head toward the camera with a gentle smile
문기둥에 기대 서기.desc_ko: 툇마루 기둥 옆에 서서 한 손을 얹고 카메라를 봄

찻잔 두 손으로 들기.pose_en: sits on the wooden veranda holding a small ceramic teacup with both hands
찻잔 두 손으로 들기.moment_en: {s} looks toward the camera over the cup with a calm smile
찻잔 두 손으로 들기.desc_ko: 툇마루에 앉아 작은 찻잔을 두 손으로 들고 카메라를 봄

camera.전신: Full-length shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from above {p} head to below {p} feet, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus
camera.무릎 위: Medium-long shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just above the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus
camera.허리 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} waist, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus
camera.허벅지 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to mid-thigh, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus
camera.3/4 전신: Three-quarter shot from eye level with a 40mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just below the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus
camera.가슴 위: Close portrait from eye level with a 70mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to mid-chest, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus
camera.클로즈업: Close-up portrait from eye level with an 85mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} collarbones with {p} face filling about two thirds of the frame height, square frame, shallow depth of field with the tile roofs softly out of focus

ground_contact_en: {P} feet rest on the pale-gray courtyard earth beside a stepping stone
style_en: natural lifestyle photography with fine film grain and realistic skin texture
